name: Build-Up Dominoes
description: Build-Up Dominoes is a western domino connecting game that uses two double-six sets to increase tile availability for larger tables and longer hands. Players place legal matching tiles to open ends and try to manage mobility and pip exposure while progressing toward hand-end conditions.

overview.description: Build-Up Dominoes is a western domino connecting game that uses two double-six sets to increase tile availability for larger tables and longer hands. Players place legal matching tiles to open ends and try to manage mobility and pip exposure while progressing toward hand-end conditions.

history.origins: Build-Up Dominoes is encountered as a modern expanded-supply connecting format that uses two standard domino sets to reduce early blocking and support larger tables.
timeline: Modern era: circulated through social play and rules collections.
history.cultural: Played as a social table game where tile duplication changes inference and increases the value of flexible connectors.
history.evolution: Using two sets increases duplication of tiles, changing end-control and safety compared with a single-set game.

setup.deck: Two double-6 domino sets shuffled together.
setup.dealing: Deal tiles by player count; remaining tiles may form a boneyard by table profile.
setup.equipment: Domino sets and optional score tracking by table profile.

rules.objective: Play legal tiles by matching exposed open ends and reach the hand-end condition defined by the table profile with the best resulting score.
rules.gameplay: Players place one legal matching tile to an open end of the shared layout. When blocked, the table profile determines whether to draw from a boneyard or pass. Hands end when a player empties their hand or when the table becomes blocked, and scoring follows the table profile.
keyRules: A tile placement must match the value of an open end.
Blocked turns are resolved by a draw-or-pass table profile.
Hand-end conditions and scoring depend on the match rules in use.

strategy.basic: Preserve flexible connectors and avoid being left with high-pip tiles.
strategy.intermediate: Because duplicates exist, do not over-trust single-tile inference from discards and visible play.
strategy.advanced: Control the open ends to reduce opponent mobility while keeping your own exits available under duplication.
tips: Duplicate tiles reduce certainty; play for robust safety rather than precise reads.
Keep multiple matching options to avoid being trapped when the table shifts.

synthesis.shortDescription: Build-Up Dominoes is a two double-six set connecting domino game where duplication changes end control and blocking dynamics.
